column1: Fujiwara Teika’s Hundred-Poem Sequence of the Shōji Era, 1200|1978|10|0|1200|8.5,5.5,4.5,5,7.5,9,2,9,7,8|Robert H. Brower; Fujiwara no Teika|Retain as a scholarly explanatory monograph whose introduction and commentary reconstruct patronage, poetic competition and composition, not merely a lyric collection or craft manual. Source 259 gives detailed reader evidence and samples; https://gwern.net/doc/japan/poetry/teika/1976-brower-fujiwarateikashundredpoemsequenceoftheshojiera-part1.pdf provides the precursor introduction. The nominated 1978 monograph is distinct from its 1200 primary sequence, so original production is 1978 and historical endpoint 1200. D=7.5 moderate source-report confidence: manuscript revisions and patronage constraints add learning, allusion detail has narrower yield. T11 Japanese court history; no T12, literary analysis dominates politics. Eligibility moderate.

Shin Kokinshu|1205|0|0||6.5,2.5,2,2,4.5,9,1,9,5,8|Various poets; Fujiwara no Teika and other compilers|Counterfactual V3: lyric anthology, not automatically fiction. Beyond poems and contextual notes, little sustained explanatory model for this collection's intellectual criteria. https://jti.lib.virginia.edu/japanese/shinkokinshu/AnoShin.ednote.html documents initial 1205 presentation and later revisions through 1210; 1205 is initial production, moderate confidence. Rodd's English translation 2015 exists. D=4.5 low confidence from source report and editorial account: varied images and conventions add distinctions but little causal explanation. No thematic deduction or central historical argument; old age alone is not the veto.

1000 Poems from the Manyoshu|1940|0|0||6.5,3,2.5,2.5,5,9,1,8.5,6,7.5|Nippon Gakujutsu Shinkōkai, selectors and translators; various poets|Counterfactual V3 for this particular modern selection, distinct from the complete ancient anthology. https://ci.nii.ac.jp/ncid/BA71586782 identifies original selected compilation 1940 and 2005 abridged republication. Source 259 reports diverse voices and poverty observations but many flat or repetitive praise poems. D=5 moderate reader-report estimate: social distinctions add learning, repeated praise adds little explanatory content. Introduction does not make sustained mechanisms the main payload. English available; not excluded merely for verse. T11/T12/H13=0, anthology rather than historical analysis.

Man’yoshu|759|0|0||6.5,3,2.5,2.5,5,9,1,9,5.5,7.5|Various poets, traditionally compiled by Ōtomo no Yakamochi|Counterfactual V3: ancient lyric anthology, not a fictional narrative and not a technical reference. https://jti.lib.virginia.edu/japanese/texts/AnoMany/index.html identifies various authors and conventional date 759. Approximate compilation date, low confidence; last dated poem does not prove exact final compilation. English selections are available, including the separately nominated 1000-poem selection. Source 259 assesses the corpus's social variety and repeated praise; D=5 low confidence for the whole collection because its detailed reading report covers a selection. Little sustained causal or strategic explanation survives removal of local poetic details. No thematic or historical-period deduction.

Kokinshu|905|0|0||6.5,2.5,2,2,4.5,9,1,9,5.5,8|Ki no Tsurayuki and fellow compilers; various poets|Counterfactual V3 for the lyric anthology. English annotated edition verified by https://ndlsearch.ndl.go.jp/en/books/R100000136-I1970023484895631915 ; conventional initial compilation 905, moderate confidence, not 1984 translation. Prefaces add literary ideas but the primary payload remains individual poems rather than transferable mechanisms. D=4.5 low confidence from catalog and source comparison: seasonal and emotional distinctions add some learning; not a prose density measurement. T11/T12/H13=0; no blanket fiction exclusion.

Unforgotten Dreams|1997|0|0||7,3,2.5,2.5,5.5,9,1,9,6,8|Shōtetsu; Steven D. Carter, translator and editor|Counterfactual V3: lyrical selection with introduction, not a doctrinal treatise merely because its poet was a monk. https://cup.columbia.edu/book/unforgotten-dreams/9780231105767/ confirms 1997 modern selection and 240 pages. Source 259 values poetic quality; no substantial generalizable explanatory framework established. D=5.5 low confidence from source report/description: contextual notes and varied poems add distinctions, much value remains aesthetic. T11/T12/H13=0. Original year refers to this selected compilation, not the earliest individual poem.

A Shropshire Lad|1896|0|0||6.5,2,2.5,2,5,9,1,8.5,8.5,9|A. E. Housman|Counterfactual V3: lyric reflections on love, death and country life, not automatically fictional narrative. Source 259 describes all 63 poems, samples and recurrent themes; original 1896 verified in cached Open Library record OL634617W. D=5 low-confidence educational-yield judgment: compact varied emotional situations, little explanatory development despite fine economy of verse. Literary quality is credited separately under prose/form precision and architecture. No dominant historical-period argument, T11/T12/H13=0.

Selected Poems|1972|0|0||6.5,2.5,2,2,4.5,9,1,9,5,8.5|Paul Celan|Counterfactual V3 for the 1972 Hamburger/Middleton selection explicitly named by source 259, not the unrelated catalog work by Catullus. Source review gives direct excerpts and reports a few memorable poems amid substantial opacity. https://www.poetryfoundation.org/poets/paul-celan verifies the poet and thematic context; the source itself identifies this 1972 selected compilation. D=4.5 moderate reader-report confidence: compressed linguistic and emotional distinctions, limited sustained explanation. Holocaust reference alone does not trigger the racial-history or single-nation-history deduction: this is a lyric collection. T11/T12/H13=0.

D=4.5 low confidence from source report and bibliography: imagery and linguistic distinctions add aesthetic learning, causal explanation is slight. Original date is not reset by translation. T11/T12/H13=0; poetry is not automatically classified as fiction.

Author bibliography https://krieger.jhu.edu/writingseminars/wp-content/uploads/sites/34/2014/03/Leithauser-CV-2012.pdf confirms 2006. Representative poems at https://www.penguinrandomhouseretail.com/book/?isbn=9780375711428 show reflective scenes of memory, grief and perception rather than mechanisms. D=5.5 low-confidence sample estimate: distinct images and situations, limited explanatory development. T11/T12/H13=0; incidental DNA imagery is not a science book.
